summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — The ALLEGRO HCAL Three-Parts Endcap driver ([#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666)) fixes the pseudo-layer position calculation used by PandoraPFA, correcting geometry information consumed downstream by particle-flow reconstruction on ALLEGRO. A new MUSIC v3 detector variant ([#658](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658)) instruments the nozzles with a three-disk Forward Tracker, revises the vertex barrel/endcap layers and layer IDs, and removes the yoke iron in favour of the HCAL barrel as flux return; while MUSIC-specific, it exercises shared drivers. The `dd4hep2root` utility ([#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)) now maps volumes to the closest predefined ROOT colour, improving visualisation of FCC geometries, and CODEOWNERS was refreshed ([#651](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/651)) to reflect current FCCee maintainers.
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — [#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524) hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, working around a Python-binding overload-resolution issue that could pick the wrong method in analysis scripts until the deprecated API is removed.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — `k4run` now accepts `--evt-max` as an alias for the Gaudi event limit ([#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)), making the mapping to `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax` explicit for users. A large refactor ([#427](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/427), follow-up [#428](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/428)) migrates the test suite's producers and consumers to functional algorithms, replacing legacy ROOT-file and Marlin-wrapper producers and consolidating CellID-metadata validation, which serves as a reference for downstream code adopting the functional pattern.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103) adds edge sorting/flipping so that graph edges are oriented from the hit closer to the IP to the outer hit, reproducing the acorn training convention required by the GNN track-finding pipeline. [#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104) adapts the material-mapping algorithm to the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct in ACTS while preserving support for released ACTS versions, and [#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97) turns silent `--compactFile` omission in CKF, GNN, and geometry-visualization option scripts into a clear argparse error.
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — `Geant4Output2EDM4hep` and its LCIO/ROOT siblings ([#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663)) now retrieve run information from the worker context and fix end-of-run locking, so that in multi-threaded `ddsim` runs the ingested run parameters and file parameters actually reach the output (fixes #1660); a new DDTest compares run and metadata trees for regression protection. The FCC MDI mask driver ([#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666)) gains a `kUpstreamTrapezoid` type in `Mask_o1_v01_geo` to support non-cylindrically symmetric synchrotron-radiation masks, coupled to k4geo #648. Additionally, [#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681) temporarily removes the CSG-based `ASSIMPWriter` CAD export path because ROOT made `RCsg` private; a replacement using only public ROOT APIs is being prepared as a follow-up, so users relying on CAD export from DDCAD should expect a brief regression.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — [#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386) extends track-validation options to IDEA (adding `--addTruthTracks` and `--runTrkValidation` in `run_digi_reco.py`) and exposes the switch through the IDEA and ALLEGRO ctest wrappers, aligning full-sim validation across the two detector concepts.
- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — [#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15) reworks the glTF conversion to shrink children that overlap their parent volume, fixes a missing-field bug in the output concatenation, tightens conversion logic, lowers `numFaces` to 1000 and bumps transparency to 100%, improving fidelity of FCC detector visualizations (particularly for IDEA where parent envelopes were previously indistinguishable from children).
- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora)** — [#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54) updates the PFO comparison script to match the new EDM4hep interface introduced in EDM4hep#520, restoring the validation workflow used to compare Pandora outputs.
- **[key4hep/k4Bench](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench)** — Two substantial regression-tooling updates land: [#187](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/187) switches memory-regression judgment from total RSS (unreliable under CVMFS page invalidation) to `peak_vmem_mb` and `mean_rss_anon_mb`, keeping RSS metrics as diagnostics; [#188](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/188) adds a reported-only Theil-Sen slope of anonymous RSS per event, versions the event-timing JSON schema, and surfaces measurement-stability information in the dashboard. In parallel, PR-Agent-based AI reviewing was introduced via the CERN AI Gateway ([#193](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/193), [#194](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/194), [#195](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/195), [#196](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/196)), running Kimi K3 with a GLM-5.2 fallback on self-hosted runners.
- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials)** — [#201](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials/pull/201) replaces the vendored copy of `dd4hep2root` with a link to the version in k4geo, and [#198](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials/pull/198) refreshes the eedE tutorial with updated screenshots and documentation of new upload/filtering functionality.
- **[HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies)** — [#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61) documents the FSR-lattice beam parameters (still GHC-based, similar at the IP to the new LCC optics), giving analysts a reference for beam conditions above the Z pole.
- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-drs](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs)** — [#88](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/88) adds a coordinator-only `production_ids` table to track DIRAC/iLCDirac production IDs per campaign-assigned request, with UI, activity-feed logging and server-side enforcement.
